author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.9 - Quieter logs: routine live-session reconnects are now info-level instead of warnings. Many ecobees silently drop the HomeKit session every several minutes and the driver reconnects within seconds — packet capture confirmed this is normal, harmless self-healing, not a fault, so it no longer logs a wall of warnings ('session dead… reconnecting' / 'live socket dropped… reconnecting'). A genuinely unreachable thermostat is still reported as a warning via the healthStatus attribute. Turn on info logging if you want to see the reconnects. (0.19.8 reverted the 2.5.1 keepalive change that couldn't run from a driver.)
